response.sql: WITH transaction_sentiment AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt_vol_ratio FROM sentimentandfundamentals s INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), order_type_avg AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_short_interest) AS order_type_avg_short_interest FROM transaction_sentiment GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT ts.transreg, ts.ordertypedist, ts.avg_short_interest, ts.avg_opt_vol_ratio, ts.avg_short_interest / ota.order_type_avg_short_interest AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_sentiment ts LEFT JOIN order_type_avg ota ON ts.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
